gen-gf-unkempt-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Expressive is the word for Unkempt, whose crossbars match its stems. Encode Sans Expanded, the sans-serif beneath it, keeps its c tips pulled well apart, so paragraphs of text move along without fuss.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-encode-sans-sc: Unkempt draws every line like neon tubing bent into letters, loud and commanding. And Encode Sans SC, plain sans with a shallow terminal curl, gives that tubing a quiet place to rest.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-encode-sans-semi-conde: Encode Sans Semi Condensed reads modern and approachable, its open counter letting the s breathe. But Unkempt does the shouting, every line traced with one marker tip, while the sans simply carries the words.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its rounded letters left open, a contemporary plain sans with no agenda. But Unkempt, its crossbars and stems equally heavy, stays up top while paragraphs below roll along smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-exo: Exo is an approachable sans-serif whose wide gaps keep even tiny sizes crisp. Unkempt, with strokes like bent pipe, handles the loud announcing, and Exo handles the quiet, steady reading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-exo-2: Stencil-cut and loud: Unkempt holds a constant weight through every stroke, sitting above Exo 2, a sans with daylight inside its curves. Loud on top, easy underneath, and nothing fights.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-faculty-glyphic: Unkempt makes no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes, which gives the headline a blunt, commanding presence. Faculty Glyphic, a modern sans-serif, keeps the text clear underneath.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang carries a faint nib-pressure swell along each round letter, so its curves finish well before they close. Fahkwang stays gentle beside Unkempt, whose joins never thin where strokes meet.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-figtree: A crossbar and stem of matching weight give Unkempt its commanding look, while Figtree sits below, drawn as if with a marker. Paragraphs in this plain sans go down smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-finlandica: Unkempt is expressive and commanding, its crossbar and stem matching in weight, a loud counterpart to the constant-width outlines of Finlandica. Let Unkempt go big; Finlandica needs only modest sizes.
